meta.notes: asset_id names the pattern texture (entity/banner/<path> and entity/shield/<path> in the resource pack); this one reuses the creeper face. translation_key is the pattern's name; add <key>.<colour> keys such as block.msm_examples.banner.ruby_mark.red to a language file. To offer it in the loom, add it to a banner pattern tag used by a banner pattern item.
